props.description: Half of all requests are questions from this list. If yours is not here, write to us on the right.

questions.question: How long does onboarding take?
questions.answer: Usually two or three business days: one for access, one for moving the data and half a day for checks. If your export is unusual, we agree the timing separately and name it before the work starts.

questions.question: Can we migrate data from another system?
questions.answer: Yes, if there is a CSV export or an available API. We move reference data, order history and users. Files over two gigabytes are moved in parts so the service stays up.

questions.question: What does support include after launch?
questions.answer: Answers during business hours, bug fixes and updates at no extra cost. Changes for your own process are quoted separately and always agreed in advance.

questions.question: How does payment work?
questions.answer: By invoice once a month, or yearly at a discount. The first month can be paid after launch: if it does not fit, we do not invoice.

questions.question: Where is the data stored?

items.docs: Один файл, ноль зависимостей, «use client». Выборы — кнопки-капсулы с aria-pressed (одиночный) и role=checkbox/aria-checked (напитки). Имя из адреса читается useSyncExternalStore (на сервере пусто, гидрация без расхождений), greeting с {name} заменяет заголовок; lede принимает {deadline}. Форма — стекло: полупрозрачный крем с backdrop-filter и светлой кромкой, за ней шалфейное свечение ::before секции. Сводка — <dl> с aria-live=polite, пустые значения показывают «—». Отправка: без action — preventDefault и экран «спасибо», с action — обычный POST с hidden-полями guest и answers (JSON). Печать — radial-gradient со «штампом» keyframes. От 56rem сетка 1.4fr/.7fr, сводка sticky. Палитра --vibeui-contact-018-*: крем #f6f1e8 / слива #2b1a24 через light-dark(), акцент терракота #b8552f, слива #4a1f36 для заголовков, шалфей #8a9a7b и песок #d9c5a5 для подписей; тёмная тема — по .dark/[data-theme] или tone.
